name: noseview
description: Local webcam nose contour consultation prototype
author: NoseView project

scripts.dev: npm run assets && vite build --config vite.worker.config.ts && vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.worker.config.ts && vite build
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/lifecycle.mjs && node tests/camera-startup.mjs && node tests/beauty.mjs && node tests/preferences.mjs && node tests/nose-presets.mjs && node tests/live-filter.mjs && node tests/profile-filter.mjs && node tests/region-controls.mjs && node tests/consultation-ux.mjs && node tests/ui-layout.mjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run make && node scripts/run-packaged-test.mjs && npm audit
